invalid_request: output_match watches concrete job output; parent observers that need communicate messages use source="parent" with events ["communicate"], and read delivered event.message in the frame. Observers send updates with `respond` (`next="send_and_continue"`), a readiness line or their findings with `respond` (`next="send_and_end_turn"`), and quiet no-action notes with `respond` (`next="log_quietly_and_end_turn"`).
